The rear panel is not visible in the photo.

risks.proof: A photo of the rear of the unit showing the power and coaxial connectors.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the rear of the antenna showing the power and coaxial ports.
Video of the antenna connected to a TV showing a clear picture.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
